### GT table: cross-conference results by power league

```{r gt-cross-conf, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Every ACC, Big Ten, Big 12, and SEC game against another power league,
# broken out by conference: wins, losses, games still to play, and the teams
# with no such game scheduled at all.
#
# Notre Dame is independent but plays a P4-caliber schedule, so its games
# count toward the P4 opponent's own column -- one-sided, since Notre Dame
# has no conference row of its own. UConn, also independent, is not included.
#
# The CSV below is a snapshot taken from collegefootballdata.com on
# September 20, 2026. Each cell already holds the rendered HTML (logos,
# scores, the grey treatment on losers), so this post rebuilds the table
# without hitting the API.

conf_table <- readr::read_csv("cross_conf_league_2026.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

year <- 2026

# ESPN's college football glyph, bookending the title block.
espn_icon <- paste0(
  "https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=",
  "/redesign/assets/img/icons/ESPN-icon-football-college.png"
)

header_html <- glue::glue(
  "<div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;'>
      <div>
        <img src='{espn_icon}' style='height: 40px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
      </div>
      <div style='flex-grow:1; margin-left: 30px; margin-right: 30px'>
        <span style='display: block; font-weight: bold; text-align: center; font-size: 24px;'>{year} Cross-Conference Games <br>by <em>Power</em> League</span>
        <span style='font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; display: block; text-align: center;'>Every ACC, Big Ten, Big 12, and SEC game against another power league (<b>plus Notre Dame</b>), broken out by conference. <br>Idle teams have no non-conference regular-season game scheduled against another P4 team or Notre Dame.</span>
      </div>
      <div>
        <img src='{espn_icon}' style='height: 40px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
      </div>
    </div>
  <br>"
)

conf_gt <- conf_table |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gtUtils::gt_theme_savant() |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = gt::everything()) |>
  gt::sub_missing(missing_text = "") |>
  gt::cols_align(align = "center", columns = gt::everything()) |>
  gt::cols_width(
    conf_label ~ gt::px(110),
    win ~ gt::px(180),
    loss ~ gt::px(180),
    remaining ~ gt::px(180),
    idle ~ gt::px(150)
  ) |>
  gt::cols_label(
    conf_label = "Conference",
    win = "Wins",
    loss = "Losses",
    remaining = "Remaining",
    idle = "Idle Teams"
  ) |>
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::html(header_html)) |>
  gtUtils::gt_border_grid(color = "black", weight = 1, include_labels = FALSE) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(gt::cell_borders(
      sides = c("left", "right", "top", "bottom"), color = "black", weight = gt::px(2)
    )),
    locations = list(gt::cells_body(), gt::cells_column_labels())
  ) |>
  # One wash per column so the four categories read apart at a glance:
  # green for wins, red for losses, yellow for unplayed, grey for idle.
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_fill(color = "#F0FDF4"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = win)
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_fill(color = "#FEF2F2"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = loss)
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_fill(color = "#FFFBEA"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = remaining)
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_fill(color = "#F3F4F6"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = idle)
  ) |>
  # Conferences have wildly different numbers of games, so cells are top-
  # aligned and the rows stay ragged rather than centering short lists.
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(v_align = "top"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = c(win, loss, remaining, idle))
  ) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(gt::html(
    "
      data via collegefootballdata.com | cfbtxt.com<br>
      <hr>
      <b>Remaining</b> games are listed under both conferences, so these repeat across rows.
      <br><b>Idle Teams</b> have no regular-season game scheduled against another P4 team or Notre Dame.<br>
      <b>Independents:</b> <b>Notre Dame is included</b> as a power-league opponent, so its games count toward the P4 team's own column. <b>UConn</b> is not included.<hr>
      Table by Chris at Bless your Chart"
  )) |>
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.size = gt::px(14),
    heading.align = "left",
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    table.width = gt::px(810)
  )

gtUtils::gt_save_crop(
  conf_gt,
  file = "cross_conf_league_2026.png",
  zoom = 2,
  whitespace = 40
)

conf_gt
```
